[2026-07-28_BITCOIN_EQUITIES_SECTOR]  
Bitcoin Equities Sector (BITCOIN_EQUITIES_SECTOR) | Class: BITCOIN_EQUITIES  

    Current Market Structure:  
    • The Bitcoin equities sector spans Bitcoin miners, corporate treasury holders (MSTR), spot ETFs (IBIT, FBTC, BITB), and financial proxies (COIN, HOOD).  
    • Sector average gravity score sits in the balanced rotation zone (~29.0), with key constituent HUT scoring 79/100 (Breakout) and MARA in golden breakout positioning.  

    Quantitative Valuation & Gravity:  
    • MicroStrategy (MSTR), Marathon Digital (MARA), Coinbase (COIN), and Riot Platforms (RIOT) anchor the sector's valuation framework.  
    • Time-weighted average price (TWAP) gravity baselines reflect expanding cost bases driven by network hash rate growth and post-halving economics.  
    • Portfolio weightings: aggressive profiles overweight top-tier miners (MARA, CLSK, IREN) and treasury anchors (MSTR); risk-averse profiles favor spot ETFs (IBIT, FBTC).  

This summary captures the core constituents, valuation anchors, and gravity metrics for the Bitcoin Equities sector.
